# 2EZ TEK

> Mobile fitness equipment repair, assembly, and maintenance serving Dallas Fort Worth, Texas. Call or text (972) 807-7232.

2EZ TEK is a locally owned fitness equipment service company based in Dallas, TX. We send technicians directly to your home or commercial facility across the DFW metroplex. No haul-away, no waiting — we fix it on-site. Founded by Robby Turner in 2019. 4.9 stars across 500+ verified reviews on Google and Thumbtack.

## Services

- Treadmill repair (belts, motors, consoles, incline systems, error codes) — $100–$400
- Elliptical repair (resistance, drive systems, stride issues, electronic consoles) — $100–$350
- Exercise bike repair (upright, recumbent, spin bikes, Peloton service) — $75–$275
- Strength equipment repair (cable machines, pulleys, weight stacks, pads) — $75–$400
- Gym equipment assembly (all brands, flat-rate assembly at your location) — $75–$200/piece
- Home gym installation (full setup, cable routing, anchoring) — $100–$800+
- Commercial gym maintenance (hotels, apartment complexes, corporate gyms, health clubs)
- Preventive maintenance (lubrication, belt tension, calibration) — $75–$150/machine
- Onsite diagnostics (identify issues before committing to repair)

## Common Questions

**How much does treadmill repair cost in Dallas?** Belt service $100–$175. Motor/board repairs $200–$400. Free diagnostic quote before work begins.

**Do you come to my home?** Yes — fully mobile, no haul-away. We come to your home, apartment, hotel, or gym anywhere in DFW.

**Do you service Peloton?** Yes. Bikes and treadmills. Resistance motors, drive belts, cranks, touchscreens.

**Do you repair commercial gym equipment?** Yes. Hotels, apartment complexes, health clubs, training studios, and corporate facilities across DFW. Maintenance contracts available.

**How long does a repair take?** Most repairs complete in 1–2 hours in a single visit. Techs carry common parts on every truck.

**Is it worth repairing vs. replacing?** Usually yes if repair cost is under 50% of replacement value. We give an honest diagnostic before any work.

**Do you assemble equipment from Amazon or retail stores?** Yes — all brands, all sources.

## About

Founded by Robby Turner. 2EZ TEK has been serving DFW homeowners, apartment communities, hotels, and commercial gyms since 2019. All technicians are trained on residential and commercial equipment. We carry common parts and consumables on every truck to resolve most repairs in a single visit.
